subject: Contingent workforce screening attestation — AuroraHealth evidence request
messages:
From: Alice Lane <alice.lane@aurorahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: security-audit@aurorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Contingent workforce screening attestation + sample artifacts request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this on quickly. As part of Aurora Health's SIG+SOC2 sampling this quarter, our security team needs evidence that Redwood's controls for contingent/seasonal contractors (temporary staff, agency hires, and interns) meet the same onboarding/offboarding standards as full-time employees. Specifically we need:

- A small representative sample (3–5 individuals) of redacted background check reports and the screening attestations for contingent workers hired between 2028-03-01 and 2028-06-30.
- The onboarding checklist used for contingent hires (I-9 verification equivalents, access approvals, device provisioning).
- Deprovisioning runbook or access revocation logs showing timely disablement after contract end.
- Chain-of-custody for artifact transfer and your recommended redaction approach for PII (we can accept DOB month/year only).

We can accept redacted samples for review, but Aurora's legal team will likely request one unredacted sample under an NDA for verification. Our requested turnaround is five business days if possible — audit window is tight.

Attachments: screening_audit_checklist.pdf (template we use)

Can you confirm who on your side will own compilation and whether you can provide an initial delivery estimate?

Best,
Alice Lane
Senior Security Programs Manager
Aurora Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lane <alice.lane@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contingent workforce screening attestation + sample artifacts request

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can compile the artifacts you requested. A few clarifying questions before we pull the files:

1) Confirm acceptable redaction standard: do you want DOB as MM/YYYY only? Are initials-only acceptable for names in the CSV roster?
2) For the unredacted sample under NDA: do you want a signed one-off NDA or will your existing procurement NDA suffice? We can route via DocuSign if required.
3) Coverage: are we focusing only on agency/contractor hires (contingent) or also interns and seasonal temps billed through payroll?

Marissa (cc'd) will lead assembling the packet. Jonas, can you confirm the access revocation logs we keep (we normally export from our IAM daily snapshot) and whether a sample export will satisfy Aurora's audit needs?

We aim to have an initial package (redacted samples + manifest) in 3 business days once you confirm redaction and NDA preference. If you need the unredacted sample sooner, we can expedite under DocuSign.

Attached: evidence_manifest_template.xlsx — this is the manifest we will fill to map artifacts to control IDs.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lane <alice.lane@aurorahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contingent workforce screening attestation + sample artifacts request

Hi Alice —

We're on it. Quick update on artifacts we'll provide (redacted by default unless we receive a signed NDA link):

- contractor_roster_q2_2028.csv (names redacted to initials; hire date and role retained)
- redaction_sample.pdf (one background check with SSN redacted, DOB as MM/YYYY)
- screening_certificates.zip (training completion certificates for the cohort; PDFs with employee id only)
- iam_deprovisioning_2028-06-export.csv (timestamps for access disablement; includes account id, disable timestamp, operator)
- chain_of_custody.pdf (log of who exported, hash notes, delivery checksum)
- evidence_manifest_template_filled.xlsx (maps each artifact to control IDs + notes on redactions)

PRIYOM: legal asked for the minimum PII we can provide. Our current guidance from Legal & Privacy is: redact SSN and exact DOB (leave month/year), remove street address, mask email local-parts (e.g., j***@example.com). We will include a short attestation signed by HR confirming checks were completed against our vendor screening provider.

JONAS: can you confirm that the IAM export will show operator and timestamp? If so we'll include the export and the runbook excerpt.

Alice — we can deliver the redacted bundle to the Drive folder below within 72 hours. For an unredacted sample, please sign the attached DocuSign powerform (link below) and we will provide a single unredacted report under Aurora's NDA.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleChainOfCustody
DocuSign powerform: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345

Thanks — I'll send the package and manifest when ready.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Lane <alice.lane@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 17:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contingent workforce screening attestation + sample artifacts request

Marissa/Kimberly —

This plan works. We will sign the DocuSign NDA today and expect to see the redacted bundle in the Drive folder by EOD Monday. Thanks for the clear redaction approach — MM/YYYY for DOB and initials-only for names is acceptable for the redacted review.

Jonas: can you please include in the IAM export a short note on the retention policy for deprovisioning logs (Aurora's auditor may ask about retention windows)?

We appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll follow up if Aurora's legal team asks for anything different on the unredacted sample.

Best,
Alice Lane
Senior Security Programs Manager
Aurora Health
